cost_basis: 2026-10-09 Toss fee counterfactual; 5bp assumed slippage; before personal income/capital-gains tax
limitations: Previously inspected development period
Adjusted-unit close-fill research proxy
Daily FX proxy, not contemporaneous bank FX quote
Incomplete point-in-time listings/corporate actions/industry data
Conservative post-settlement cash timing
No live account or real trading validation

evidence.name_labels: Existing public dashboard labels; display only, not historical model inputs.

temporal_extension.cost_basis: 2026-10-09 Toss fees applied counterfactually; adjusted fractional close-fill proxy; before personal tax

inference.inference_note: Retrospective research. Paired circular block bootstrap; short-span intervals are descriptive. No live approval.

limitations: Data were downloaded before registration and may have informed other project research; this is not a blind holdout.
Source has no complete historical listing, corporate-action or delisting provenance.
Daily FX and adjusted fractional close-fill units remain research proxies.
Current 2026-10-09 fee assumptions are applied counterfactually, not historical fee schedules.
A short favorable interval cannot satisfy 126 forward paper days or approved live observation.

items.additional_gap: Minimum-order normalization can remove necessary risk-reduction sales; final executable quantities require recertification.
items.repair_status: Separate directional repair prototype and independent net-order certificate passed 16 tests; not integrated into this frozen replay.
items.scope: Synthetic zero-gap boundary case reproduced; occurrence count and return impact in the historical replays not yet quantified.
items.summary: Opposing stock trade legs can consume modeled fees while the executor fills only the net quantity, changing cash, NAV and risk feasibility.

items.also_applies_to: Guarded research retains the same candidate filter; final-order certification does not fix candidate selection.
items.repair_status: Separate tie-preserving selector passed 11 tests and all saved-date permutation checks; not integrated into running replays.
items.scope: All four saved forecast inputs checked. Development row-order-sensitive days: KR 201/390 and US 76/391; extension 3/48 for each country. No return or holdings effects recomputed.
items.summary: The shared top-20 mean forecast candidate cutoff selects a subset of tied boundary assets by stored ticker order, changing candidate membership under row reversal.

limitations: Both periods were inspected before designing these variants; all are development reexperiments.
Execution price/FX bounds are declared scenarios, not guarantees on future fills.
Daily FX, adjusted fractional units and observed session calendars remain research proxies.

The shared top-20 mean forecast cutoff breaks boundary ties by stored ticker order; candidate membership can depend on row order. The separate tie-preserving selector is not used in these frozen runs.
Unreachable constraints remain failures even when a solver finds the least-violating sale-only plan.
The frozen execution optimizer can plan simultaneous opposing legs while the executor nets orders; projected fees, cash and risk can differ. Execution-plan validity is not established.
The breach-day metric checks realized volatility and CVaR with the original tolerance; it does not certify all currency, concentration or order constraints.
A delayed order is revalidated only in execution-aware variants; this is an intentional policy difference.
v02_research.risk_breach_metric_scope: postfill volatility or CVaR with original 0.001 tolerance; not every constraint

limitations: Already inspected periods; descriptive scores only, no independent validation or significance claim.
Five-session outcomes overlap; individual stock-day rows are not independent trials.
Per-date stock averages receive equal date weights within each country; missing outcomes are counted.
Three quantiles do not describe the complete return distribution or joint portfolio losses.
Forecast scoring does not establish transaction-cost-adjusted portfolio performance.
